title: Confluent Platform Onboarding cohort, public, per seat (USD)
description: Confluent Platform Onboarding (CFLT-CPOB-V1) is a live online Kafka training cohort from Scalytics for teams running Confluent Platform on premises or on Kubernetes. It runs over three weeks with 15 live sessions of 90 minutes, hands-on labs and recordings. Week 1 is a shared foundation for all roles: Kafka architecture, Schema Registry, Shift Left and a Flink preview. Week 2 runs Developer and Architect tracks: producer and consumer tuning, Kafka Streams, scalability, high availability, Event Sourcing and CQRS. Week 3 is the Operator track: CFK on Kubernetes, monitoring, scaling, diagnostics and disaster recovery. The trainer is Dr. Mirko Kämpf, a former Confluent solution architect. Scalytics is a Confluent partner. The listed price is per participant in a public cohort.
